name: Career and College Promise (dual enrollment at Wake Tech)
what_you_do: Take college classes tuition-free while in high school, in more than 40 academic programs. Many courses also count for high school graduation. Choose college transfer or career and technical.
who_can_apply: High school juniors and seniors with a 2.8 or higher unweighted GPA, or test scores showing college readiness. The career path also accepts a principal recommendation in place of the GPA. You must keep a 2.0 college GPA after two courses.
deadline_text: Dates change each term. See the Events and Important Deadlines calendar on the Wake Tech CCP site. The page lists no specific dates.
how_to_apply: Use the New CCP Students page and the Advising and Registration page on the Wake Tech CCP site. Or email CCP staff with questions.
notes: Only one application per student. Use a personal email address. Wake County Public School students name their principal or a stand-in on the application.
